text: Tadhg's band is playing the Crown on May 14. He asked if I could get there early to help carry the amp in. Need to text him the day before to confirm a time.
Marisol invited me to her housewarming on Saturday. She's finally moved out of the flat on Elm Street and into a little terrace with a garden.
Pick up dry cleaning, return the library books, and buy stamps before the post office closes at five.
Joseph ran the half marathon this morning in just under two hours. His knee held up, which he was worried about all week. Must send him a congratulations message tonight.
Ming's piano recital is June 3rd. She's very nervous about the Chopin piece and keeps saying she'll forget the middle section. I should text her good luck that morning.
Lindiwe and her husband are hosting a dinner on 6/21 for their tenth anniversary. Dress code is smart casual. She hinted that a nice bottle of red would go down well.
Moira's book club Christmas party is cancelled this year because the host is having building work done.
Valentina got into the city youth orchestra! Her mum told me at pickup. First rehearsal is next Thursday.

Emil is playing Benedick in Much Ado at the community theatre, opening night April 9. I'm going with Louis. Remind me to ask Emil how the second weekend went, since his director is coming back to review it.
Car MOT is booked for the 12th. Drop it off at eight and get the bus to work.
Jen called. Her brother Malik is getting married in Lisbon on September 20th and she's already panicking about the speech.
Pieter's five-a-side team won the league final last night. He scored the winner, apparently, and hasn't stopped talking about it.
Sunil's leaving do is on Friday at the Red Lion from six. Chip in for the card and gift before Wednesday.
Laila mentioned her daughter has her first ballet show on May 2. She's only four and has been practising her bow in the kitchen every evening.
Anders loves jazz, especially old Blue Note records. Worth remembering for his birthday in March.
Had coffee with Khadija. She's been struggling since the breakup and isn't sleeping much. I should check in on her at the weekend, maybe take her for a walk.
Imogen is throwing a surprise fortieth for Callum on July 18th. Don't mention anything to him. She wants everyone at the restaurant by seven, an hour before he arrives.
Akira's judo grading is two weeks from Saturday. He trains four nights a week and said he feels ready. Ask him how it went the next day.
Graham invited us to his barbecue on Labor Day weekend. Julia is bringing the potato salad and I'm doing the drinks.
Note to self: renew passport before the end of the month. The photo booth in the station takes cards now.
Henrik's choir has a concert at St Mary's on December 7. He says it's mostly Bach and some carols. His wife Ifeoma is singing the solo in the second half.
Chioma's dog Biscuit went missing yesterday afternoon. She's beside herself. Found the poster on the community page, so share it and text her tonight.
Heather's cat Pepper turned one last week. She threw a tiny party with a fish-shaped cake. Absolutely ridiculous and very sweet.
Hiroshi is racing in the cycling sportive on 8/30, the hundred-mile route. He's been training since spring. Message him afterwards to see how it went.
Oliver and Ilse have their wedding rehearsal dinner on October 10th and the wedding the day after. I'm doing a reading at the ceremony, so need to practise the week before.
Nadia's debating team made it to the national final! It's in Manchester on March 22nd. She's excited but also terrified of the cross-examination round.

Long call with Tadhg tonight. His dad is in hospital again, and the gig he'd been looking forward to on the 15th is off because he wants to stay near home. He sounded exhausted. Need to ring him on Sunday, and maybe drop off some food the day after his dad's scan on Tuesday. He mentioned his sister Moira is flying back from Dublin on Monday to help, so at least he won't be alone. I should also ask whether the band's rescheduling or just cancelling the whole tour.
Marisol's housewarming was lovely. The garden is tiny but she's got big plans for tomatoes. Send her the photos from the evening.
Grocery list for the weekend: oat milk, lemons, rice, and something for the dinner party on Saturday. I'm making the lamb.
Joseph wants to do the Berlin marathon next September. He's already looking at training plans.
Ming played brilliantly, by all accounts. Her teacher said she should audition for the conservatory in the spring. Must congratulate her properly when I see her on Thursday.
Louis said his partner Valentina has her driving test on June 9th, the morning after his birthday dinner. She's on her fourth attempt and dreading it.
Emil hates musicals, so don't drag him to the Les Mis tickets Jen got. He'd rather watch the football.
Malik's stag do is in Edinburgh, May 23 to 25. I said I'd come for the Saturday only. Book the train before prices go up.
Pieter's son Thomas starts Under-11s football trials on Wednesday. Pieter is more nervous than the kid is.
Dentist moved to Tuesday at 4:30. Leave work early.
Sunil is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Keep in mind for the dinner on the 17th.
Laila's daughter's ballet show was adorable. She waved at the audience halfway through her routine. Laila says next term she wants to try tap.
Anders and his wife are celebrating their silver wedding anniversary with a party at the golf club on November 15. Invitation came in the post today. RSVP by the first.
Khadija texted that she's feeling a bit better and has signed up for pottery classes on Thursday evenings.
Callum works night shifts at the hospital now, so any plans have to be weekends.
Akira passed his grading! Black belt. His mum cried, he said. Get him a card before the club dinner next Friday.
Graham and Julia's barbecue was rained off, so they're doing a curry night indoors instead on the 6th.
Henrik said the concert went well, though Ifeoma had a cold the day before and nearly couldn't sing. She pulled it off. Ask how she's feeling now.
Finally fixed the bike puncture. Need to book a service for it before the charity ride on 7/12.
Chioma found Biscuit! He was hiding in a neighbour's shed for two nights. She's taking him to the vet tomorrow morning just to be safe.
Heather is training for her first triathlon on August 3rd. The open water swim scares her more than anything. Text her good luck the night before.
Hiroshi finished the sportive in seven hours and said he never wants to see a bike again. He's already signed up for next year.
Ilse's mum is coming over from Rotterdam for the wedding and staying three weeks. Ilse seems a bit stressed about it.

Nadia's team came second in the final. She's gutted, but her coach Mr Haddad told her it was the best showing the school has ever had. I should message her this week and tell her how proud we all are.
Bumped into Tadhg Murphy, Taddy to everyone at school. He's running a pub quiz every Wednesday now at the Anchor.
Joseph's sister Imogen is having her first solo art exhibition opening on April 28. Joseph said she's been preparing for a year. I'd like to go to the private view.
Moira's grandson Oliver is in the school nativity on December 12. She's knitted his sheep costume herself.
Book a table for six for Saturday night, then email everyone the address. Ask the restaurant about a gluten-free menu too.
Marisol is going to her niece's quinceañera in Texas on June 14th. She's flying out the Wednesday before and back the Monday after.
Thomas Nowak from accounts invited the whole team to his band's gig at the Lexington on March 8th. He plays bass. Probably should go, at least for the first set.
Valentina passed her driving test! Fourth time lucky. She's celebrating with drinks on Friday.
Dinner at Lindiwe's was gorgeous. She made bobotie and her son Joseph played guitar for us afterwards. Lovely evening.
Clean the gutters this weekend and order the new hose. Nothing else on until the 20th.

Talked to Graham at the school gate. He's coaching his daughter's netball team this season and they have their first match on Saturday morning. He's worried because half the girls have never played. Julia's going to bring oranges for half time. I should go along and cheer, and maybe text Graham afterwards to see how they got on.
